title: Bayern crowned BBL champions
description: ALBA Berlin - Bayern 82-88 Bayern Munich lifted BBL trophy. They overcame ALBA Berlin in Game 4 of the Final to claim League title. Carsen Edwards (185-G-1998, college: Purdue) was unstoppable with 29 points. He was named the MVP. Bayern eked out a 22-21 lead after ten minutes. But ALBA sank 25 points in the second term to secure a 46-44 halftime advantage. However the visitors turned the tables in the third quarter. Bayern used a massive 21-6 run to silence the hosts. ALBA poured in 30 points in the fourth quarter but it was too late as Bayern rolled to the title. Leandro Bolmaro (198-G/F-2000) and Devin Booker (205-F/C-1991, college: Clemson) produced 10 points each for Bayern. Sterling Brown (197-G-1995, college: SMU) responded with 25 points for ALBA. Yannick Wetzell (206-C-1996, college: SDSU) had 11 points in the loss.
